assets.name: OTs-14-1A Groza-1「雷暴」
assets.prompt: Create exactly ONE finished inventory weapon sprite for the indie survival game TidalLine. OTs-14-1A Groza-1, a very compact Soviet-style bullpup assault rifle in 7.62x39. Flat dark steel and worn black polymer, stubby barrel with short cylindrical muzzle device at RIGHT, tall distinctive integrated carry handle spanning above receiver, curved dark 30-round AK magazine BEHIND pistol grip toward butt at LEFT, small squared rear buttplate, forward integral vertical grip below short front end. No separate conventional rifle stock, no grenade launcher, no silencer, no optic, no tan furniture. Bullpup layout absolutely essential: left-to-right order buttplate, curved magazine, pistol grip, foregrip, muzzle. Style: restrained retro pixel art, hard stepped dark outline, coarse deliberate square pixel clusters, small muted palette, cool gunmetal highlights, sparse beige edge wear. Full weapon entirely visible in frame; side-on with very slight top/three-quarter hint, horizontal muzzle pointing RIGHT and 5 degrees upward, buttstock LEFT. Emphasize a clear readable silhouette that survives reduction to 40 pixels wide. Long gun occupies 85% canvas width centered, ample fully transparent empty margin. No labels, letters, typography, rarity frame, gradient background, shadow, fog, glow, vignette or additional objects. True transparent background including all spaces through stock, trigger guard, carry handle and grip gaps. This is a new single weapon bitmap asset, not a sheet, not a photograph or rendered product shot.
